name: SELENE night sample handling

original_specification.name: SELENE night sample handling
original_specification.description: A proposed lighting arrangement for night handling with declared task fixtures.
use_cases: Night handling with declared task fixtures
original_specification.sources: Onboard spot and optional separately declared gripper lamp
original_specification.geometry: Sources attached to actual mounts; terrain and arm occlude them
original_specification.contribution_policy: Relative fixture contribution, no solar or sky ambient
original_specification.authoring_method: Original procedural rig specification; author numeric emitters and physical cards, then calibrate in the fixed reference scene. No third-party assets included.
validation: Dark regions require a real light path and no automatic sky fill

scale_policy: Scale light positions/sizes once to an explicitly selected subject; never scale the subject.
limitations: Native GPU realization uses a finite rectangular emitter; a directional/spot angular model is retained as intent, not silently equated to a measured fixture.
Vacuum mode: no atmospheric sky, fog, star dome or undeclared ambient light.
Solar direction and radiance are authored relative values, not site ephemerides or measured lunar photometry.
